_comment: To re-enable Jumpgate on the live portfolio, move the object inside _commentedOutProjects back to the top of projects[].

_commentedOutProjects.title: Jumpgate: Zero-Trust Agentic AI Landing Zone & Vending Machine
_commentedOutProjects.summary: Self-service Dual-VPC cloud landing zone and 14-step Vending Machine Agent that compresses 4 to 6 weeks of setup and IM8 security verification into under 3 minutes, driving $1.96M in realised public sector ARR (+$1.46M pipeline).
_commentedOutProjects.architecture: Separates Ingress (Regional HTTPS ALB with TLS 1.3, Cloud Armor OWASP WAF, Serverless NEG, IAM-locked Cloud Run) from Egress (Secure Web Proxy Layer 7 domain allowlisting, Private Service Connect to Vertex AI, non-root SHA-256 pinned containers) in Terraform. Paired with a 4-agent, 14-step ADLC pipeline enforcing an >=0.85 LLM-as-a-Judge quality gate and passing 14/14 Ingress runtime and 18/18 Egress static security checks.

projects.title: Antigravity Agent Tracer Plugin
projects.summary: Real-time visual step timeline and three-lane architecture explorer for AI agents, turning raw background transcripts into clear Timeline, Architecture, and Simplified views.
projects.architecture: Lightweight zero-dependency Python 3 server streaming live conversation logs every 1.5 seconds into an interactive Vis.js and SVG frontend. Automatically catches failed tool calls, strips internal log noise, and lets engineers inspect child subagent runs inline.

projects.title: Antigravity Harness
projects.summary: Unified multi-agent workspace combining a customisable two-by-two split view, parallel agent chat sessions, embedded Agent Tracer timeline, scheduled tasks, and live 200k memory tracking.
projects.architecture: Streams per-turn prompt, cached-memory, and output token counts from the local language service, tracks memory usage against the 200k token limit, and lets engineers prompt multiple agents side by side.

projects.title: Smart Meeting Prep and Dossier Agent
projects.summary: Two-stage scheduled agent that pulls context across Calendar, Gmail, Chat, Drive, and People Directory to deliver verified one-page meeting briefings.
projects.architecture: Pairs an evening preview briefing with a one-hour pre-call reminder. Backed by a 5-scenario, 36-check automated test suite that catches invented speaker titles, broken links, and duplicate alerts before anything is sent.

projects.title: EduVerse
projects.summary: Awarded 2nd Place Overall at NUS, Singtel, and Millennium Management LifeHack 2025. Adaptive learning platform pairing interactive lessons with an ~85% accurate student mastery model.
projects.architecture: Modular React, Next.js, and TypeScript web platform running on Cloudflare Workers for fast global response times, paired with a Python and PyTorch student mastery engine that tailors practice topics automatically.

projects.title: MINDSync (Lobang-Octagon)
projects.summary: Built for Hack4Good. Centralised multi-branch event and volunteer platform for MINDS, replacing scattered spreadsheets and manual sign-up forms across centres.
projects.architecture: Role-based web application built with TypeScript, Next.js, and Supabase supporting staff, caregivers, and volunteers with shared calendars, conflict-free sign-ups, and live shift coverage tracking.

projects.title: Multi-Cloud Serverless Application
projects.summary: Full-stack serverless web application showcasing portable cloud architecture, live data sync across open browser tabs, and automated deployment pipelines.
projects.architecture: React and Vite frontend hosted on Vercel backed by Supabase authentication and live database sync, paired with AWS serverless resources managed through automated Terraform templates and GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Uncertainty Quantification & XAI for Battery Analytics
projects.summary: First-author paper at APSIPA ASC 2025 (IEEE Xplore) from A*STAR research. Deep learning framework that predicts battery health inside a verified 95.2% confidence band.
projects.architecture: Combines calibrated deep neural networks with SHAP and LIME feature explanations across the McMaster and Oxford datasets so engineers see both the confidence range (0.012 calibration error) and whether voltage or heat drove each forecast.

projects.title: Real-Time Semantic Segmentation & Multimodal Captioning
projects.summary: Live computer vision pipeline that highlights objects pixel by pixel on webcam video while describing each scene in plain English.
projects.architecture: Processes live video streams through a PyTorch DeepLabV3+ vision model to colour-code distinct objects via OpenCV, paired with the BLIP vision-language model to generate live scene descriptions.

projects.title: TransportGPT
projects.summary: Built for the NUS NCS Innovation Challenge 2024. Traffic intelligence system combining live road camera feeds, vehicle counting, and natural-language route updates.
projects.architecture: Pairs real-time YOLOv3 vehicle detection on road camera feeds with traffic flow forecasting and language models to summarise congestion bottlenecks and suggest clearer alternative routes.

projects.title: Panasonic Commercial HVAC Control Dashboard
projects.summary: Industry project creating a centralised web dashboard to monitor and control commercial air-conditioning systems across building floors.
projects.architecture: Combines a Svelte web interface and interactive 3D floor-plan visualiser in Three.js with a live WebSocket backend streaming room temperatures, unit status, and energy usage.

projects.title: Autonomous Air Defence System (DSTA BrainHack 2024)
projects.summary: Semifinalist at DSTA BrainHack 2024 (TIL-AI). Voice-controlled AI pipeline that turns spoken mission instructions into live aircraft detection on screen.
projects.architecture: Dockerised system linking OpenAI Whisper speech-to-text, a custom language parser (>85% accuracy) that extracts target descriptions, and a vision-language detector (~80% box alignment accuracy) to lock onto matching aircraft.

projects.title: OnlyNotes Note Sharing Application
projects.summary: Collaborative Android study application for sharing class notes, flashcards, and study groups, built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Firebase.
projects.architecture: Native Android app structured with clean MVVM architecture and Jetpack Compose screens, backed by Firebase sign-in, real-time Cloud Firestore document sync, and cloud file storage.

projects.title: LobangCube Financial Wellness Platform
projects.summary: Interactive personal finance and budgeting app built with Python and Streamlit to visualise monthly cashflow, savings progress, and spending habits.
projects.architecture: Python and Streamlit web application that organises personal spending records, tracks budget goals by category, and renders interactive visual charts.
